  - |
    cat > /home/cloud-user/install-ocp.sh << 'SCRIPTEOF'
    #!/bin/bash
    set -e
    cd /home/cloud-user
    
    # Skip if cluster is already installed (pattern deploy)
    if [ -f /home/cloud-user/ocp-install/auth/kubeconfig ]; then
      echo 'Cluster already installed, skipping.'
      exit 0
    fi
    
    # Wait for network. Test DNS reachability to 8.8.8.8 (a TCP/UDP:53
    # resolve) rather than ICMP ping, since gateway egress policy may
    # block icmp while still allowing DNS/HTTPS the install needs.
    echo 'Waiting for network...'
    net_ok() { timeout 2 bash -c '</dev/tcp/8.8.8.8/53' &>/dev/null; }
    for i in $(seq 1 15); do
      net_ok && break
      sleep 2
    done
    if ! net_ok; then
      echo 'ERROR: No network connectivity after 30 seconds'
      exit 1
    fi
    echo 'Network OK'
    
    OCP_VERSION=4.20
    
    # Download openshift-install and oc if not present
    if [ ! -f openshift-install ]; then
      echo "Downloading openshift-install $OCP_VERSION..."
      curl -L -o /tmp/openshift-install.tar.gz https://mirror.openshift.com/pub/openshift-v4/x86_64/clients/ocp/stable-$OCP_VERSION/openshift-install-linux.tar.gz
      tar xzf /tmp/openshift-install.tar.gz && rm -f /tmp/openshift-install.tar.gz
      echo "Downloading oc client..."
      curl -L -o /tmp/openshift-client.tar.gz https://mirror.openshift.com/pub/openshift-v4/x86_64/clients/ocp/stable-$OCP_VERSION/openshift-client-linux.tar.gz
      tar xzf /tmp/openshift-client.tar.gz && rm -f /tmp/openshift-client.tar.gz
      sudo mv oc kubectl /usr/bin/
      echo "Downloaded openshift-install and oc"
    fi
    
    echo ''
    echo '================================================'
    echo 'OCP Agent-Based Installer Ready'
    echo '================================================'
    echo ''
    echo 'install-config.yaml:  ~/ocp-install/install-config.yaml'
    echo 'agent-config.yaml:    ~/ocp-install/agent-config.yaml'
    echo 'Pull secret:          ~/pull-secret.json'
    echo 'openshift-install:    ~/openshift-install'
    echo ''
    echo 'To create agent ISO and install:'
    echo '  cd ~/ocp-install'
    echo '  ~/openshift-install agent create image --dir .'
    echo '  # Serve ISO and boot nodes via BMC'
    echo '  ~/openshift-install agent wait-for install-complete --dir . --log-level debug'
    echo ''
    echo ''
    # Auto-run agent-based installer
    INSTALL_START=$(date +%s)
    echo "Install started at $(date)"
    BMC_PASS='pw'
    echo 'Creating agent ISO...'
    cd /home/cloud-user/ocp-install
    cp install-config.yaml install-config.yaml.bak
    cp agent-config.yaml agent-config.yaml.bak
    [ -d openshift ] && cp -a openshift openshift.bak
    /home/cloud-user/openshift-install agent create image --dir . --log-level debug 2>&1 | awk '{print strftime("[%H:%M:%S]") " " $0; fflush()}' | tee /home/cloud-user/create-image.log
    
    echo 'Agent ISO created. Serving via HTTP and booting nodes...'
    # Open firewall for ISO serving (script runs as cloud-user)
    sudo firewall-cmd --add-port=8080/tcp --permanent 2>/dev/null && sudo firewall-cmd --reload 2>/dev/null || true
    cd /home/cloud-user/ocp-install
    nohup python3 -m http.server 8080 > /tmp/http-server.log 2>&1 &
    HTTP_PID=$!
    echo "HTTP server PID: $HTTP_PID"
    
    # Boot each CP node via Redfish virtual media
    BASTION_IP=$(hostname -I | awk '{print $1}')
    ISO_URL="http://${BASTION_IP}:8080/agent.x86_64.iso"
    echo "ISO URL: $ISO_URL"
    
    for BMC_IP in 192.168.100.10 192.168.100.11; do
      echo "Mounting ISO on BMC $BMC_IP..."
      # Get system UUID from sushy
      SYS_ID=$(curl -s -u admin:$BMC_PASS http://${BMC_IP}:8000/redfish/v1/Systems | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['Members'][0]['@odata.id'].split('/')[-1])")
      echo "  System: $SYS_ID"
      # Insert virtual media (Systems path, HTTP, with auth)
      curl -s -u admin:$BMC_PASS -X POST "http://${BMC_IP}:8000/redfish/v1/Systems/${SYS_ID}/VirtualMedia/Cd/Actions/VirtualMedia.InsertMedia" \
        -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
        -d "{\"Image\": \"${ISO_URL}\", \"Inserted\": true, \"WriteProtected\": true}" || true
      # Reboot — UEFI boot order is hd,cdrom so empty disk falls through to ISO
      # After agent writes CoreOS to disk, next reboot boots from disk first
      curl -s -u admin:$BMC_PASS -X POST "http://${BMC_IP}:8000/redfish/v1/Systems/${SYS_ID}/Actions/ComputerSystem.Reset" \
        -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
        -d '{"ResetType": "ForceRestart"}' || true
      echo "Booted $BMC_IP from ISO"
    done
    
    
    echo 'Waiting for cluster installation to complete...'
    /home/cloud-user/openshift-install agent wait-for install-complete --dir /home/cloud-user/ocp-install --log-level debug 2>&1 | awk '{print strftime("[%H:%M:%S]") " " $0; fflush()}'
    OCP_EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
    INSTALL_END=$(date +%s)
    ELAPSED=$(( INSTALL_END - INSTALL_START ))
    echo ''
    echo '================================================'
    if [ $OCP_EXIT -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "Install FAILED at $(date) (exit code $OCP_EXIT)"
    echo "Total time: $(( ELAPSED / 60 )) min $(( ELAPSED % 60 )) sec"
    echo '================================================'
    kill $HTTP_PID 2>/dev/null
    exit 1
    fi
    echo "Install completed at $(date)"
    echo "Total time: $(( ELAPSED / 60 )) min $(( ELAPSED % 60 )) sec"
    echo '================================================'
    # Eject agent ISO via Redfish virtual media
    echo 'Ejecting agent ISO from nodes...'
    for BMC_IP in 192.168.100.10 192.168.100.11; do
      SYS_ID=$(curl -s -u admin:$BMC_PASS http://${BMC_IP}:8000/redfish/v1/Systems | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['Members'][0]['@odata.id'].split('/')[-1])" 2>/dev/null)
      curl -s -u admin:$BMC_PASS -X POST "http://${BMC_IP}:8000/redfish/v1/Systems/${SYS_ID}/VirtualMedia/Cd/Actions/VirtualMedia.EjectMedia" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{}' >/dev/null 2>&1
    done
    # Write static MOTD with cluster credentials
    KUBEADMIN_PW=$(cat /home/cloud-user/ocp-install/auth/kubeadmin-password)
    printf '\nOpenShift Console: https://console-openshift-console.apps.ocp.ocp.local\nUsername:          kubeadmin\nPassword:          %s\n\n' "$KUBEADMIN_PW" | sudo tee /etc/motd >/dev/null
    # Trust the OCP CA so Firefox doesn't show cert warnings
    export KUBECONFIG=/home/cloud-user/ocp-install/auth/kubeconfig
    oc get secret -n openshift-ingress router-certs-default -o jsonpath='{.data.tls\.crt}' 2>/dev/null | base64 -d | sudo tee /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/ocp-ingress.pem >/dev/null && sudo update-ca-trust
    # Save kubeadmin password into Firefox via headless Selenium
    if ! find /home/cloud-user/.mozilla/firefox -maxdepth 2 -name cert9.db 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then
      firefox --headless --no-remote >/dev/null 2>&1 &
      FXPID=$!
      sleep 5
      kill $FXPID 2>/dev/null; wait $FXPID 2>/dev/null || true
      sleep 2
    fi
    if [ ! -x /usr/local/bin/geckodriver ]; then
      curl -sfL https://github.com/mozilla/geckodriver/releases/download/v0.37.0/geckodriver-v0.37.0-linux64.tar.gz | sudo tar xz -C /usr/local/bin/ || true
      sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/geckodriver 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
    python3 -c 'import selenium' 2>/dev/null || pip3 install --user selenium 2>/dev/null || true
    echo '' | base64 -d > /home/cloud-user/ocp-autologin.py
    chown cloud-user:cloud-user /home/cloud-user/ocp-autologin.py
    chmod 755 /home/cloud-user/ocp-autologin.py
    pkill -x firefox 2>/dev/null || true
    sleep 2
    export GECKODRIVER_PATH=/usr/local/bin/geckodriver
    python3 /home/cloud-user/ocp-autologin.py https://console-openshift-console.apps.ocp.ocp.local 2>&1 || true
    # Cleanup: remove cached ISO, temp files, and pull secret from disk
    rm -f /home/cloud-user/pull-secret.json
    rm -rf /home/cloud-user/.cache/agent/ /tmp/http-server.log /tmp/cookies /tmp/*.zip /var/tmp/dnf-*
    dnf clean all 2>/dev/null
    # Kill the HTTP server used to serve the agent ISO
    kill $HTTP_PID 2>/dev/null
    SCRIPTEOF
    chown cloud-user:cloud-user /home/cloud-user/install-ocp.sh
    chmod 755 /home/cloud-user/install-ocp.sh
